title: Umami Creamy Canadian Hazelnut Pasta
description: A pescatarian friendly Canadian dish featuring hazelnuts and beurre-monte, rich in umami flavor and creaminess, perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the chopped hazelnuts to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add the beurre-monte to the skillet and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the heavy cream to the skillet and stir until the sauce is creamy and well combined.
Stir in the grated grana padano cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the dried thyme, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir until well combined.
Add the cooked fettuccine pasta to the skillet and toss until the pasta is well coated with the sauce.
Stir in the diced smoked salmon and cook until heated through.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with additional hazelnuts and grana padano cheese if desired.
